Method of Attack: Infects WordPress sites by hiding in pirated (nulled) themes and plugins
Deploys a backdoor in all installed theme files with timestamp resetting to evade detection
Backdoor receives inbound and outbound instructions to deploy malicious code, activate malvertising injections, manipulate search engine results, and remove code remotely
Scans hosting server to infect other WordPress sites on the same server
Uses black hat SEO techniques including backlink and keyword injection for viral marketing and malware distribution
Phoning back to command-and-control (C2) servers with compromised site info and backdoor password
Self-healing infections and extensive C2 infrastructure to maintain persistence
Attack Vector: Installation of pirated (nulled) WordPress themes and plugins from malicious distribution sites
Compromised legitimate sites used for viral marketing and malware distribution
Indicators of Compromise: Nulled content distribution sites including download-freethemes.download
More than one hundred WP-VCD C2 domains detected by Wordfence
Black hat SEO domains and propeller ads domains used in the campaign
